title: Higher striatal glutamate in male youth with internet gaming disorder.
authors: Klar J, Slotboom J, Lerch S, Koenig J, Wiest R, Kaess M, Kindler J.
figures: Voxel placement. T1 structural image of one representative participant using spectrIm-QMRS. The magnetic resonance spectroscopy voxel (20 × 20 × 20 mm, green box) was placed in the left striatum

Regression analysis with the square-root transformed data showed a significant effect of group on Glx levels (Glx/Cr ratio). In the striatum a significant higher level of Glx/creatine ratio ( p  < 0.05) was detected in the IGD group as compared to HC. Mean and distribution,  HC  healthy controls,  IGD  Internet gaming disorder,  Glx  glutamate + glutamine,  sqrt  squareroot
